baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative بأي binds the focus words at indices 2-4, while the dual suffix addresses two respondents.
baseline_models.mechanism: A selectable set of bestowed favors is sourced in a Lord whose rule includes repair and completion; تكذبان makes the decisive act not mere ignorance but actively classifying that care as false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the interrogative's selectable body of evidence.
Repair, nurture, and completion cast the giver as one who brings recipients toward wholeness.
Attributing falsehood makes denial an active verdict on the supplied evidence.

changed_reading.after: A forensic demand that the pair identify which concrete act of sustaining care can honestly be declared false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins ءالاء, ربكما, and emphatic Form II تكذبان inside a dual-address question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch field gathers oath, attached liability, a lordly pact, and a charge that proves true only when carried through. The question can therefore renew a relationship whose truth is tested in performance.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making gives the questioned favors a solemn pledge-like edge.
A right or liability following its holder makes the two addressees carriers of an attached obligation.
A binding pact frames lordship as a covenanted relation rather than bare possession.
A charge fulfilled or failed makes conduct the proof of whether the response is true.

changed_reading.before: A question about assenting to a proposition.
changed_reading.after: A covenant-performance test asking whether the paired recipients will carry an entrusted relation through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual verb and interrogative permit the focus clause to operate as a call awaiting more than one answering voice.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped branches of ء ل و supply sequence and a voice following a voice. Joined to active attribution of falsehood, the clause can be heard as a response cue, not only a statement about belief.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another supplies an antiphonal image and assigns the question a call-and-response function.
Following in sequence makes each answer a position in an ordered exchange.
Declaring something false gives the awaited response a determinate stance.

changed_reading.after: A call that positions two hearers to answer in sequence and thereby enact their stance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus directly couples favors, an enduring Lord-relation, and the act of falsification.
baseline_models.mechanism: One denial branch names provision that disappears instead of lasting as expected, while a رب branch supplies staying and duration. The question can challenge the assumption that expiry proves a favor false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the provision whose truth is being evaluated.
Staying and lasting supply the durability expectation attached to the source.
Milk that fails to last supplies the concrete image of calling provision false when expectation outlives it.

changed_reading.before: Denial means rejecting that a benefit was given.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also be the mistaken verdict that a time-limited provision was never a true favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy initiates teaching, measured creation, and the disclosure of meaning. These cues turn the favor-question inward: the capacity by which evidence becomes intelligible is itself part of the evidence being judged.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors remain the focus object but expand to include capacities rather than only external goods.
Tender mercy supplies the governing disposition from which the sequence begins.
Disclosure to a knower makes teaching an event of evidence becoming accessible.
Estimating and measuring creation makes the recipient a deliberately fitted participant.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the very instrument with which a true or false verdict is voiced.
Active attribution of falsehood turns misuse of disclosed understanding into the audited act.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 moves from mercy through teaching and creation to taught articulation before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tenderness, disclosure, measured creation, and communicative clarification; I infer that the supplied faculty is what the refrain audits. A live alternative is a list of independent favors without this inward turn.

changed_reading.before: The pair evaluates gifts standing outside themselves.
changed_reading.after: The pair must use a gifted faculty of disclosure to judge that faculty's own merciful source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial reckoning becomes a human balance, justice, a prohibition on short measure, and an earth shared by creatures. Denial therefore acquires an operational form: falsifying favor by deforming the measured commons.

activation_trace.role: A charge that succeeds or fails lets practical conduct prove or falsify the response.
Counting and calculation supply a cosmos whose regularity is accountable rather than arbitrary.
The balance of justice transfers measured order into an ethical instrument.
Equity supplies the norm by which human weighing answers cosmic measure.
Shorting measure supplies a concrete action that makes the entrusted balance fail.
Creatures on earth identify the public beneficiaries harmed when measure is falsified.

structural_cues: 55:5-10 descends from celestial calculation to commanded weighing and then to earth placed for all creatures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, just balance, short measure, and a shared earth; I infer that violating the measure is an enacted denial of the favor. The alternative is that cosmic and commercial measures are parallel examples without a causal ethical transfer.

changed_reading.after: تكذبان also names practical falsehood: keeping the words while cheating the measure that makes shared life possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact recurrence supplies the missing performance environment for the focus-only voice and sequence branches. Each intervening scene changes the referent of بأي, so the same words demand a renewed answer rather than one reusable assent.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies a voice following a voice and seeds the antiphonal reading.
The first contextual recurrence realizes another answering voice in the sequence.
Following in sequence makes recurrence cumulative rather than redundant.
Repeated attribution of falsehood requires the hearers to reposition themselves after each new scene.

structural_cues: The complete dual-address clause occurs at 30 non-focus refs in the packet in addition to 55:25, alternating with changing descriptive scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence plus branch images of vocal and sequential following; I infer a performed response protocol. The live alternative is emphatic repetition with no expected antiphonal enactment.

changed_reading.before: One rhetorical question asks for one settled answer.
changed_reading.after: A recurring response protocol asks the pair to renew their stance as the evidence changes around the identical clause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visible human formed from sounding dry matter is paired with the hidden jinn formed from mobile flame. The dual morphology of 55:25 now convenes materially unlike witnesses under one question and one Lord.

activation_trace.role: Shared lordship places unlike recipients under one authority and evidentiary demand.
The manifest human opposed to wildness and jinn supplies the visible member of the pair.
Dry clay with a pottery-like sound gives the human side a bounded, resonant materiality.
Hidden beings supply the unseen counterpart to the manifest human.
A lapping flame gives the hidden counterpart mobile and unstable material form.
Kindled fire completes the contrast with sounding clay and binds both origins to created media.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 use parallel creation clauses immediately followed by the dual refrain at 55:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired creation, visible-hidden contrast, and the dual refrain; I infer that the dual identifies human and jinn as reciprocal witnesses. The grammar alone could still address any two hearers, so identification comes from sequence.

changed_reading.before: The dual suffix is an unspecified rhetorical pair.
changed_reading.after: The question establishes evidentiary parity between visible and hidden beings whose opposite materials offer neither side an exemption.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two broad waters meet across a maintained middle and do not transgress; valuable brilliance then emerges. The favor is not only the pearl but the governed interface that lets difference contact difference without collapsing into disorder.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors are widened from objects to the enabling relation that produces them.
Mixing and disorder supply the live risk against which governed meeting operates.
Two opposed things coming together supplies contact without presuming sameness.
The middle between two supplies a productive interval rather than a sealed wall.
Transgressing a limit supplies the blocked failure mode that preserves the interface.
Bringing something out of concealment turns the maintained relation into visible yield.
Sparkling brilliance makes the hidden yield perceptible and valuable.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 orders meeting, a non-transgressed interval, and emergence before the ship scene and 55:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, middle, non-transgression, and emergence; I infer that restraint enables the yield. A live alternative is simple juxtaposition, with the barrier and pearls not causally related.

changed_reading.before: The favors are enumerable products such as pearls.
changed_reading.after: A maintained boundary that permits contact without erasure is itself a favor because it makes emergence possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, constructed and raised vessels run through the sea as conspicuous markers while the verse assigns them to Him. Human making is retained but nested inside the conditions of motion, buoyancy, and orientation.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and authority make derivative agency the central issue in the ship's attribution.
Flowing motion supplies the vessel's realized passage through an enabling medium.
Bringing a thing into being preserves construction as a real act inside the larger mechanism.
Sea-riding supplies the practiced human domain in which construction depends on a given medium.
A visible mark that guides makes the mountain-like vessel public evidence as well as transport.
Attributing falsehood becomes the false severing of human craft from the order that lets it work.

structural_cues: 55:24 begins with the possessive وله and places raised vessels in the sea like landmarks immediately before 55:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, motion, sea-riding, guidance, and divine possession; I infer that enabling order makes human agency derivative without erasing it. The alternative is a simpler statement of ownership with no agency analysis.

changed_reading.before: The refrain follows a natural bounty unrelated to human technique.
changed_reading.after: The refrain audits whether navigators falsely privatize successful engineering by detaching craft from its enabling order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question is followed by universal passing and a remaining, honored Face. This reverses the durability baseline: a provision can be true precisely as a passing medium that redirects attention to a source not exhausted by it.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before lets the favor-question carry a residual accounting frame.
Staying and lasting lodge durability in the Lord relation rather than necessarily in each gift.
Provision that fails to last supplies the mistaken expectation that transience equals falsehood.
Cessation after a span of persistence makes passing the universal condition of recipients.
Continuance locates genuine duration on the other side of universal passing.
Face as the self makes what remains personal source rather than an abstract residue.
Noble generosity keeps the remaining source continuous with the earlier giving.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 places universal passing against the remaining Face; ج ل ل at 55:27 is branchless and is used only for this structural contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passing, remaining self, and generosity; I infer that expiry redirects rather than disproves benefaction. The alternative is only an ontological contrast between creation and creator, with no revision of how favor is recognized.

changed_reading.before: A favor proves true by continuing to satisfy expectation.
changed_reading.after: A passing favor can prove true by exposing the difference between a temporary medium and the remaining generous source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired weighty communities are deliberately addressed, invited to test their capacity by crossing the cosmic bounds, and told that passage requires an overpowering authorization or proof. The rhetorical denial becomes an operational claim exposed under load.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true only when carried through supplies the stress-test logic.
Deliberate turning toward an affair makes the coming address purposeful rather than incidental.
Weight identifies the two communities as consequential loads placed under direct address.
Capacity supplies the claim that the hearers are challenged to demonstrate.
Clean passage to the far side gives the autonomy claim an observable success condition.
Compelling proof or authority supplies the indispensable condition that defeats self-sufficient passage.

structural_cues: 55:31 directly names the dual الثقلان, and 55:33 repeats the challenge to human and jinn across the bounds of heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a capacity challenge, repeated verbs of passage, and an exception for سلطان; I infer an experiment that tests the denial of dependence. سلطان may alternatively mean granted permission rather than evidentiary proof, but either reading blocks autonomous success.

changed_reading.before: The refrain asks whether the pair verbally denies dependence.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding challenge lets the pair operationalize that denial and discover that every successful crossing still bears authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: All ask Him in 55:29, yet in 55:39 no human or jinn is asked about guilt; recognition by visible marks and seizure follow. The recurring focus question is therefore not a request for missing information but a device that elicits and embodies a stance.

activation_trace.role: Declaring falsehood supplies the stance repeatedly made legible by the refrain.
Asking and requesting establish creatures as dependent petitioners before the later reversal.
The same asking branch, now negated, removes any need for an information-gathering interrogation.
Recognition by an effect or mark supplies immediate knowledge of the prior stance.
A visible sign of condition makes denial embodied and readable rather than merely remembered speech.
Being taken to account for fault turns recognition into consequence without another verbal examination.

structural_cues: 55:29 has universal asking, 55:39 negates asking about guilt, and 55:41 replaces it with recognition by marks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ask/no-ask reversal and visible recognition; I infer that repeated answers have formed a diagnostic stance rather than informed an ignorant questioner. The alternative is only a change of judicial phase with no backward effect on the refrain.

changed_reading.before: The interrogative seeks an answer that supplies information.
changed_reading.after: The interrogative repeatedly positions the hearer until the answer is visible without any later question.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired occurrence of الإحسان around its recompense supplies a return structure inside the garden sequence. The covenant reading becomes reciprocal: received excellence solicits excellent action, and denial is a broken return rather than mere failed description.

activation_trace.role: A binding pact supplies the relational frame in which return can be owed.
Fulfilling or failing a charge makes reciprocity the behavioral truth test.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return arrow explicitly.
Beneficent action appears on both sides of the relation and defines the quality of gift and response.

structural_cues: 55:60 is itself an interrogative, framed by the identical refrain at 55:59 and 55:61 within the garden sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense and mirrored beneficence between two refrains; I infer that recognition is completed by returning good through good action. The alternative confines 55:60 to future reward and leaves the refrain as verbal acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Favor travels one way from giver to passive beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: Favor opens a reciprocal circuit in which truthful recognition takes the form of beneficent return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close joins stable growing good, the name as a public designation, lasting lordship, and generosity. The refrain's demand culminates not in exhausting the inventory but in truthfully attributing every changing item to its source.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the many items whose attribution remains at issue.
Attributing falsehood sharpens the closure into a contest between true and false naming of source.
Stable, growing good gathers the changing favors into a durable generative quality.
A name that publicizes and indicates supplies the act of explicit source-attribution.
Staying and duration make lordship the persistent referent behind the changing catalogue.
Noble generosity identifies the named source as giver rather than merely controller.

structural_cues: 55:78 closes the surah by naming the Lord after the final refrain; ج ل ل at word 5 is branchless and is used only as a structural closure cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blessing, name, lasting lordship, and generosity; I infer that the answer sought by the refrain is correct attribution rather than exhaustive enumeration. The alternative is a doxological close with no retrospective function.

changed_reading.before: The pair must finish counting which favors are real.
changed_reading.after: The pair must name the stable generous source truthfully while the forms of favor continue to change.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because reproductive branches of mercy and reading are carried into the focus through رب's nurture; it remains anchored in ربكما and ءالاء as bestowed formation. Render it only as a gestational material analogy, never as a claim that القرآن or ءالاء lexically means womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ربكما at focus index 3 supplies nurture, while ءالاء at index 2 supplies what that nurture brings forth.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion anchor the focus in a process that brings recipients to formed capacity.
Bestowed favors supply what can be carried and brought forth through that process.
The female womb supplies a containing medium for the analogy of merciful formation.
A womb gathering pregnancy turns recitation's gathering field into an image of held disclosure.
Bringing creation into being gives the gestational analogy an emergence point.

changed_reading.before: Teaching delivers a finished gift to an already formed hearer.
changed_reading.after: Merciful teaching can be carried as a gestational process that forms the hearer capable of answering the favor-question.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The last-breath branch belongs to a non-dominant split mapping and is therefore form-distant, but 55:26-27 gives it an unusually exact passing/remaining environment while the focus still anchors it in ءالاء. Render it as a threshold resonance, not as a lexical gloss of ءالاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping attached to focus word ءالاء at index 2 supplies a final-breath image immediately before the passing/remaining contrast.

activation_trace.role: The last gasp supplies the focus clause with a breath-threshold resonance.
Cessation after persistence turns the next verse into the threshold's universal horizon.
Continuance supplies what becomes perceptible beyond the ending breath.
Face as self gives the remainder a personal referent rather than leaving it abstract.

changed_reading.before: The refrain is one more question inside ongoing life.
changed_reading.after: The refrain can resonate as a last-breath threshold asking what the passing recipient will still recognize as remaining.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it activates an animal-motion idiom under كذب, yet it remains anchored directly in focus تكذبان and is sharpened by the running ships before it and universal stopping after it. Render it as rhetoric and pacing, not as a replacement meaning for denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تكذبان at focus index 4 carries a branch in which forward motion stops and looks back.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage, stopping, and looking behind turns the denial-word into an image of retrospective interruption.
The ships' flowing motion supplies the forward run immediately before the rhetorical stop.
A remainder that follows what came before makes the backward review an accounting of prior evidence.
Coming to an end raises the stakes of the pause before movement finally ceases.

changed_reading.before: The refrain interrupts the ship description only to repeat a formula.
changed_reading.after: The refrain acts as a deliberate stop-and-look-back checkpoint between successful motion and the disclosure that all motion ends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The beautiful-bitter plant and deceptive cloth branches are visually driven and branch-distant, but both attach directly to focus ءالاء and تكذبان and are reactivated by the rose-oil sky and fine patterned spread. Render this as an analogy about unreliable surfaces, never as a claim that favors are literally a shrub or cloth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus ءالاء at index 2 and تكذبان at index 4 jointly expose tension between attractive appearance, experienced value, and truthful classification.

activation_trace.role: A plant beautiful to sight but bitter to taste supplies a split between surface appeal and experienced value.
A variegated cloth that deceives by its state makes appearance itself capable of false testimony.
Rose color supplies the transformed sky's attractive and disorienting visual surface.
Oil or coating supplies a surface whose fluid sheen destabilizes ordinary recognition.
Fine patterned spreads reactivate textile appearance in a positive setting and prevent a one-way suspicion of beauty.

changed_reading.before: Recognition sorts favor from falsehood by obvious appearance.
changed_reading.after: The question also tests whether the pair can judge gifts truthfully when beauty, bitterness, terror, and patterned surfaces refuse a simple visual classification.

strongest_changes: 55:24 makes the refrain test whether successful human navigation is falsely detached from the order that enables it.
55:26-27 breaks the assumption that a favor must last: passing media can disclose the remaining generous source.
Exact recurrence converts one question into an antiphonal response protocol, while 55:39-41 suggests that the response becomes a visible stance rather than information supplied later.
Measure, non-transgression, and reciprocity make denial behavioral through false weighing, autonomous overreach, and failed return.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's split mappings sustained several live readings at once: bestowed favor, oath and attached liability, antiphonal sequence, remainder, and last-breath threshold. Context assigned these to different mechanisms instead of collapsing them into one safe paraphrase.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و activations come from a non-dominant mapped root and should remain explicitly exploratory even when repetition or 55:26-27 fits them closely.
The claim that the sea-boundary enables the pearl-yield is a reader-supplied causal arrow; the packet also permits mere sequence or juxtaposition.
Human and jinn are the strongest contextual referents of the dual suffix, but the focus grammar alone does not force that identification.
The appearance model is a cross-domain analogy and must not displace the ordinary favor and denial senses.
